item.summary: The Government of India has constituted a High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat to undertake a review of India’s banking sector and recommend structural, institutional, regulatory and legislative reforms necessary to make it globally competitive, financially inclusive, and resilient for Viksit Bharat, 2047. Union Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs, Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman…
item.title: The Government of India Constitutes the ‘High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat’
